class.name: ARAnchorTracker
class.brief_description: Game-created world anchor applied with the camera packet being drawn.
class.description: Create through ARView.create_anchor_from_hit(hit) or ARView.create_anchor(pose). Successful creation starts [constant PAUSED] until a usable camera packet is applied. Failure returns null and pushes one warning. Inputs must be finite rigid world-from-anchor transforms in metres, with unit scale and positive determinant; creation requires a running, normally tracking session. Hit creation requires the currently presented frame/generation, the current uninterrupted tracking interval and a still-tracking source plane. A hit saved across later presentation, tracking loss or reset is stale. Android hit creation uses ArTrackable_acquireNewAnchor on the current native plane; free creation uses ArSession_acquireNewAnchor. iOS creates an ordinary ARAnchor at the requested pose for either method, without a plane-parent relationship. The presented hit pose is submitted to the current native session; it does not reconstruct the historical map. [member source_plane_id] is provenance, not an ongoing parent. Plane centre/extent changes do not move an anchor through a saved plane offset. Trackers have type XRServer.TRACKER_ANCHOR and names pocketar/anchor/<generation>/<id>. Filter XRServer results by this class to distinguish them from detected planes. ARView.add_anchor_node(anchor) creates a stock [XRAnchor3D] directly under the view's private [XROrigin3D]. Keep scale, yaw and offsets on descendants. The helper leaves show_when_tracked false; use its tracking_changed signal for explicit visibility policy and gate input/physics separately. The inherited default pose is valid only in [constant TRACKING], with high confidence and zero velocities. Map correction is not physical velocity. ARKit ordinary anchors expose no independent tracking confidence; usability derives from camera/session state and membership in the sampled frame. Pose updates apply from the same packet as the camera before ARView.packet_applied. Anchor-only changes under a repeated camera timestamp do not publish extra packets. ARFramePacket has no public anchor collection. Temporary loss/suspension retains native ownership and the last transform, invalidating tracking until a fresh usable sample. Removal, terminal loss, reset, generation change and uninitialize stop the tracker permanently. Old packets/callbacks cannot revive it. Source plane subsumption/removal or disabled plane finding does not by itself end the anchor. Android session recreation loses anchors; iOS configuration changes without reset retain them. Call ARView.remove_anchor(anchor) to unregister and release native ownership, including while suspended. Repeated removal by the owner is harmless; foreign trackers are rejected. Freeing a helper or dropping a game Ref does not remove the anchor, and removal does not free game nodes. Retained stopped trackers remain readable and own no native handle. Do not mutate inherited provider-owned tracker state or remove it through XRServer. Use one anchor per nearby rigid group and remove it when finished. There is no library count cap; native tracking cost is device-dependent. Anchors do not persist across reset/process death or guarantee zero drift, and provide no shared/cloud/geospatial alignment.

members.member: Opaque identity, never reused within [member session_generation].
Owning session generation. A generation change permanently stops old anchors.

Originally requested plane ID, including when creation resolves a subsumed replacement; zero for free creation. A negative debug-plane ID creates a free native anchor on phones. Clearing that debug plane does not remove the anchor.
Current [enum TrackingState]. Lifecycle invalidation is immediate even without a new camera packet.
Requested world-from-anchor pose at creation, then the last usable applied pose. Preserved while paused/stopped but invalid for new interactions in those states.

signal.name: tracking_state_changed
signal.description: Deferred notification coalesced to the latest state. Inherited pose signals and XRAnchor3D.tracking_changed remain synchronous. ARView.anchors_changed reports deferred membership changes; use ARView.packet_applied for a matching camera/anchor pair.

constants.constant: The applied camera packet contains a usable anchor pose.
The anchor retains identity and its last transform but has no usable pose. Includes accepted creations awaiting their first eligible packet.
The anchor is permanently stopped, unregistered and released from native ownership.
